summary: Eureka Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K disclosing a one-month charter extension after its September 3, 2026 initial business combination deadline. Marine Thinking Inc., the Canadian autonomous-ship target under an October 29, 2025 business combination agreement, funded the $8,253.03 monthly extension fee into the trust account, pushing the deadline to October 3, 2026; extensions run monthly to July 3, 2027. Eureka issued Marine Thinking an unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note for the same amount, payable on deal close or note maturity. Watch deal progress and monthly funding risk.
